## Validation

- [ ] `./hub test` and `./hub lint`
- [ ] Compose configuration validated
- [ ] Target-host/GPU validation completed or marked not applicable

## Security and privacy

- [ ] No secrets, model weights, runtime data, private conversations, or backups were committed
- [ ] Tool permissions and remote exposure are unchanged or explicitly documented

## Rollback
